name: MatchRule
description: How to pair records of one type with records of another type.

target_type.description: Record type it is matched to (right side)

mode.description: one_to_many lets a single source match several targets whose amounts add up (e.g. a bank deposit = several payments)

skip_targets_linked_from.description: Ignore targets that a record of this type already links to (e.g. qbo_deposit: skip payments QuickBooks has already deposited)

min_score.description: Suggestions below this score are dropped

auto_confirm_score.description: Suggestions at or above this score are confirmed automatically (0 = never)

criteria.description: Per-criterion settings: { amount: {weight, required, tolerance_abs, tolerance_pct}, date: {weight, required, window_days}, reference: {weight, required}, counterparty: {weight}, name: {weight}, lines: {weight} }
